title: GEISS AG - One step ahead
content:
Overview:
We as GEISS AG stand for precision and innovation in plastic processing. Since our founding in 1948, we have led the development of thermoforming systems, CNC machining solutions, and automation technologies. Our product portfolio offers state-of-the-art technology, known for quality and reliability, tailored to meet the needs of various industries. Guided by our motto, “one step ahead,” we continuously advance technological innovation to deliver efficient and future-ready solutions to our clients.
